bugs.evidence: Failure text: 'clk cycle -1: fast mode ... latched xfer#1 E0=-1 ... busy edges expected [(73, 0)], actual []'. E0=-1 means the env never time-stamped the accepting edge, and an empty list means it saw no busy edge at all, not a wrong cycle. A separate regression entry reports that results differ on re-run with the same seeds and code. RTL: spi_ctrl sets busy_q on start_acc (visible at cycle 1) and clears it on end_stb. spi_clkgen decodes end_stb at tick j=2W+1 in cycle (2W+2)N, so busy is 0 in cycle 1+(2W+2)N=73. That matches REQ-014 and RefModel.schedule()['busy_fall'].

bugs.root_cause: In fast (event-driven, cycle_check=False) mode the testbench's transfer monitor does not reliably catch the accepting edge or the busy transitions: it logs E0=-1 and an empty busy-edge list even though busy rises and falls. The result changes between identical runs, which marks a testbench race rather than DUT behaviour.
bugs.requirement: REQ-014 (busy high from cycle 1 to 1+(2W+2)N exclusive; 73 for W=8, N=4), checked via REQ-005 test_sck_divider
bugs.suggested_fix: Test side, ports and spec only: in fast mode, arm the edge watchers on busy, sck and cs_n before driving start, then time-stamp each change by counting rising clk edges from the accepting edge. The accepting edge is the first rising clk edge with start=1, busy=0, rst_n=1 (REQ-001). Sample after RisingEdge+ReadOnly, never on value-change callbacks racing the clock. If any watcher has not recorded the accepting edge, fail with 'monitor error' rather than reporting a REQ-014 mismatch. Re-run test_sck_divider at least twice with RANDOM_SEED=1 and require identical, passing results. Do not change the expected busy fall cycle 1+(2W+2)N.

bugs.actual: The property is reported failed with an empty counterexample ([]).
bugs.evidence: By hand, the RTL puts SCK edge k at 1+(k+1)N (spi_clkgen ticks at (j+1)N, sck_q toggles on edge_stb for j<2W). The harness counts an edge in cycle c when busy(c)=busy(c-1)=1, so the count shows from c+1. The last edge at 1+2WN is therefore counted by 2+2WN, which is at or before done at 1+(2W+1)N for N>=4. edge_cnt and wl_lat are cleared at reset and at accept (rst_n&&start&&!busy), in step with DUT start_acc and wl_q. Under these rules no post-reset trace violates edge_cnt==two_w when done=1. The reported counterexample is empty ('[]'), so no failing trace was shown.
bugs.expected: ap_sck_edge_count passes the bounded proof (depth >= 400), or fails with a non-empty trace that shows a real post-reset transfer with done=1 and an SCK edge count other than 2W.
bugs.root_cause: The formal harness gates ap_sck_edge_count only on past_valid and relies on initialiser values (past_valid, edge_cnt, sck_q, busy_q = 0) instead of an observed reset. If the flow does not honour those initial values, the property can fail at step 0 on unconstrained state, which gives an empty counterexample with no reachable post-reset violation.
bugs.requirement: REQ-025 / REQ-003 (SCK edge count per transfer equals 2W; bounded proof depth >= 400)
bugs.suggested_fix: Ports and spec only: make the harness independent of initial values. Add a reset_seen register, set on any clk edge with rst_n=0, and require it (together with $past(rst_n)) before ap_sck_edge_count, ap_sck_edge_count_fall and ap_sck_edges_max fire. Reset the helper registers sck_q and busy_q on rst_n=0 as edge_cnt is. This matches REQ-018: behaviour is defined from reset, and am_reset already assumes reset in the first cycle, so no reachable behaviour is excluded and the 2W check is not relaxed. Keep the trace export on and re-run the bounded proof at depth >= 400. If it still fails, attach the non-empty trace for re-triage.

bugs.actual: The check reports FAIL with an empty counterexample, so there is no reset-rooted trace showing mosi=1 in a no-transfer cycle. The failure cannot be reproduced as a port-level stimulus sequence.
bugs.evidence: reports/regression_failures_2.json: only failure is 'property ap_mosi_zero_when_idle failed (counterexample: [])', which has no trace steps. RTL walk (rtl/spi_shift.v): mosi_q becomes non-zero only on start_acc with cpha=0 (busy rises on the same edge in spi_ctrl) or on shift_stb=edge_stb&(lead_edge==cpha_q), and edge_stb needs spi_clkgen running_q, which is 1 exactly while busy=1 (both set on start_acc, cleared on end_stb or reset). mosi_q<=0 on cs_rise_stb at tick 2W, cycle 1+(2W+1)N, before busy falls at tick 2W+1, cycle 1+(2W+2)N. tick_cnt=2W+1 gives no edge_stb in between. For cpha=1, mosi_q<=0 at acceptance, and the first shift is tick 0, visible in cycle 1+N, so mosi=0 in cycles 1..N, matching the window 'cpha_lat && cyc<=n_ext'. Reset clears mosi_q, busy, cpha_lat and cyc together. The other assertion with no $past gate, ap_done_implies_busy, uses the same cyc/n_lat helpers and did not fail, so the cyc==t cycle numbering is consistent with the RTL.
bugs.expected: Per REQ-017 and testplan REQ-025 practice: a bounded proof from reset (rst_n=0 in the first cycle, all other inputs free, depth >= 400 so that complete N=4 transfers of 73 cycles and back-to-back transfers in all cpha values are covered) either passes ap_mosi_zero_when_idle or returns a concrete reset-rooted trace with mosi=1 while busy=0, or mosi=1 in cycles 1..N of a cpha=1 transfer.
bugs.root_cause: The formal check for ap_mosi_zero_when_idle reports a failure with no reset-rooted counterexample, most likely because it is checked from an unreachable start state (induction/unbounded step) rather than as a bounded proof from reset. Its port-level helper state (cpha_lat, cyc, n_lat) cannot be tied to the DUT's state, so the property is not inductive even though the RTL meets REQ-017 on every path from reset.
bugs.suggested_fix: Test side only, in terms of ports and spec. Run ap_mosi_zero_when_idle (and the other formal_top assertions) as the bounded proof the testplan specifies: start from reset (am_reset), leave all other inputs free, use depth >= 400, and attach the failing step and trace to the report. Do not change or weaken the property itself: it encodes REQ-017 exactly (mosi=0 when busy=0, and for cpha=1 in cycles 1..N before the first leading SCK edge). If the bounded run then shows a real reset-rooted trace, send it back to Dex for reclassification as DESIGN (rtl/spi_shift.v). If an unbounded proof is required, raise that with a human, because port-only helper state cannot make this property inductive.
